results.title: Stock Market Midday, Oct. 13: Bank Earnings and Chip Pressure Drive Mixed Trading
results.author: Emma Newbery
results.description: Major stock indexes traded mixed on October 13, 2026, as bank earnings kicked off the season with varied results and semiconductor stocks faced significant selling pressure. The S&P 500 fell 0.25%, the Nasdaq dropped 0.37%, and the Dow declined 0.18%. Goldman Sachs gained on strong earnings, while Wells Fargo and Johnson & Johnson declined on disappointing results. Semiconductor stocks, particularly Micron Technology, slid over 5% amid intensifying global competition and Chinese chip innovations.

results.title: Small-Business Optimism Dips in September
results.author: Na
results.description: Pre-market futures showed mixed signals as investors paused on AI stocks, with the Dow up 420 points while the Nasdaq fell 217 points. Oil prices dropped 1.5% amid Middle East tensions, and bond yields declined. Small business optimism dipped for the second consecutive month in September. Major financial institutions reported Q3 earnings with mixed results: JPMorgan Chase missed estimates, Goldman Sachs significantly beat expectations, Wells Fargo delivered mixed results, and Johnson & Johnson beat on earnings but missed slightly on revenue.
